overview_description.description: Scribenote is an AI-powered medical scribe tailored to help veterinarians by automating and streamlining the documentation process. Veterinary practices often struggle with extensive, time-consuming paperwork, leading to stress and inefficiencies. By utilizing artificial intelligence, Scribenote reduces the administrative burden, enabling veterinarians to focus more on patient care and less on paperwork.

about_short_description.short_description: Scribenote offers an AI-powered medical scribe to help veterinarians simplify documentation, improving work-life balance.

product.name: Scribenote AI Scribe
product.description: An AI-powered tool that converts veterinary appointment speech into structured clinical notes in SOAP format for documentation.

product.name: Adaptive Templates
product.description: Customizable templates that allow veterinarians to tailor clinical notes to their preferred style and clinic requirements.

product.name: Teams Mode
product.description: A multi-user feature allowing veterinary care teams to collaborate and manage clinical documentation within Scribenote.

product.name: Desktop Widget for PIMS Integration
product.description: A desktop application widget that enables easy export and transfer of completed clinical notes into various practice management software systems.

product.name: Scribenote for Students
product.description: A free AI scribe service for veterinary students, interns, and residents to assist with clinical note-taking during their education.
